en.headline: Police arrest second man over dog found hanging from tree in Tai Po
en.dek: Officers found animal traps and cages near a stone house on Ma Wo Road after a woman reported the mistreatment of a stray that her brother had fed for a year.
body: Police said they arrested a 67-year-old man on Monday on suspicion of cruelty to animals in connection with a dog found hanging dead from a tree outside a stone house on Ma Wo Road in Tai Po.
A 54-year-old man had been arrested the previous evening on the same suspicion after his sister reported finding the animal, which he had fed for about a year, suspended from the tree.

During the investigation, officers discovered animal traps and cages in the area around the residence. Both men are being detained for further inquiries. The Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals removed the dog’s body for examination.

zh.headline: 大埔唐狗被吊樹死亡 警方再拘一人涉殘酷對待動物
zh.dek: 警方在馬窩路石屋一帶發現捕獸器及捕獸籠，案中唐狗由其胞弟飼養約一年。
body: 警方表示，周一以涉嫌殘酷對待動物拘捕一名67歲男子，與大埔馬窩路石屋外一棵樹上發現的狗隻屍體有關。
前一晚，警方已以同樣罪名拘捕一名54歲男子。其胞姊報案指發現該狗隻被吊在樹上，該男子約一年前開始飼養這隻原屬流浪狗的唐狗。
調查期間，警方在居所一帶發現捕獸器及捕獸籠。兩人現正被扣留調查。愛護動物協會已將狗隻屍體帶走檢驗。
